flow.label: Multi-Agent Data Analysis (Database)
flow.name: taskflow_agent_db_analysis_template
flow.description: Extract → profile & plan → analyze → verify numbers → visualize → report: four agents collaborating on one database analysis pipeline.

config.goal: Profile the upstream dataset first: meaning and type of each column, row count, missing values and anomalies, analyzable dimensions. Then, around the user question, propose 3-5 high-value analysis questions with exact metric definitions. Output: profile summary + analysis plan. Do NOT start analyzing yet.

Answer each planned question from upstream: verify with sql_query first, compute with code_interpreter when needed. For each question give the conclusion + key numbers + one-line explanation. Finish with a structured analysis summary.

Independently recompute every key number in the upstream conclusions with SQL or code — never trust the upstream calculation process. Mark each item 'confirmed / corrected' with the difference explained. Output a review table.

Compose a business-facing analysis report from the upstream profile, conclusions and review notes: title, core conclusions (at most 3), key data, trends and anomalies, actionable recommendations. Use the reviewed numbers.
